feature: Research evaluation frameworks for rules, skills, and agent trajectory
problem: Eval pipeline lacks calibration, trajectory scoring, rule effectiveness testing, and has 7 UNCERTAIN verdicts from fragile behavioral heuristics. No external framework comparison to validate current approach.
proposed_solution: Research spike producing .harness/docs/spike-eval-research.md with baseline analysis, external framework survey, and concrete improvement proposals.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Document exists at .harness/docs/spike-eval-research.md with sections §0-§5
AC2: §0 Baseline maps all behavioral heuristic branches in _evaluate_behavioral() with fragility ratings
AC3: §0 identifies root causes for each UNCERTAIN verdict in the latest eval run
AC4: §1 Landscape covers at least 5 academic benchmarks and 4 industry frameworks with comparison table
AC5: §2 Rules/Skills proposes a concrete ablation methodology with statistical test and tooling design
AC6: §3 Trajectory proposes at least 5 deterministic trajectory checks implementable without LLM calls
AC7: §4 LLM Judge identifies specific problems in current judge_with_llm() and proposes phased fix plan
AC8: §5 Synthesis extracts at least 10 steal/adapt patterns from external frameworks
AC9: §5 proposes at least 4 follow-up tasks with enough detail to become state.json entries
AC10: Each proposal in §2-§4 maps back to a specific gap identified in §0 Baseline
AC11: state.json updated: spike-eval-research verified, follow-up tasks registered, direction updated
AC12: Breadcrumb logged for spike completion
edge_cases: EC1: Proposals must be grounded in what the pipeline actually does (session_judge.py, scenario YAML format, sandbox.py), not generic advice
EC2: External framework references must be real (verifiable URLs, not hallucinated tools)
EC3: Follow-up tasks must not duplicate existing tasks in state.json
verification_method: Evaluator reads spike doc, cross-references against session_judge.py source, validates proposals are concrete and implementable, checks state.json and breadcrumbs for proper updates
